classification: Behavior-changing observer-lifetime defect repair; no formulas, evaluation order, cache update, numerical acceptance or CLI retry changes.
findings: Production registration calls exist only in TriangleAdaptive construction. SubMesh owns physical vertices and elements and destroys elements first, including populated move assignment. Adapter and both initial/estimator constructors pass SubMesh-owned physical node pointers.
Serial Model deletes complete meshes; curve sample owners release different node objects from the copied physical vertices. General foreign NodeAdaptive observer copies are not globally repaired.

Current fixtures declare actual vertex owners before triangle owners or use qualified SubMesh ownership. Controlled parent/sample foreign observer entries remain non-owning and are not consumed after their triangle dies.
Slice 23 prohibits synthetic triangle copy/move and maintains current vertex registration during ReplaceNode. Arbitrary protected mutation and expired borrowed-node clients remain invalid.

The historical 31-case element probe permitted an expired final observer after failed adoption. Its oracle is strengthened to require the exact live prefix; older negative reports retain their original probe scope/hashes.
Estimator hidden/duplicate root ownership remains a static open finding requiring a separate repair. Logical rejection, cache refresh and full-process/parallel/LSan/UBSan remain open.
